:::{#exr-indicator-selection-practice}
#### Selecting one entry with an indicator vector

@thm-indicator-selection turns reading one entry of a vector
into a [dot product](#def-dot-product).
Let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{5 \\ -1 \\ 8 \\ 2}.
$$

Find $\vecf{e}_3 \cdot \vx$,
where $\vecf{e}_3$ is the [indicator vector](#def-indicator-vector) with $4$ entries.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-indicator-selection with $j = 3$.

:::

:::
